website.title: Website
website.description: What the public marketing site says about the company: contact details, social links, search settings, legal pages, pictures and the announcement banner. Nothing goes public until you publish.
website.saved: Saved. It goes public when you publish.
website.fixFields: Some values are not valid. See the messages beside the fields.
website.unpublished: {{count}} change(s) are saved but not public yet.

problems.email: Enter an email address like name@company.com
problems.phone: Use international form: start with + and the country calling code
problems.url: Enter a full web address starting with https://
problems.handle: A handle such as @name, or a full web address
problems.locales: Language codes like en, sw or pt-BR, separated by commas
problems.token: Must contain {title}, where the page title goes

company.note: Everything here appears on the public site. Leave out anything you do not want shown. Phone numbers are written in international form.
company.legalNameHint: As registered. Used in legal pages and the footer.
company.optionalDisplay: Optional. Shown on the site if filled in.
company.phonesHint: One per line, in international form.
company.formTargetHint: A web address that receives the form, or an email address.
company.appUrlHint: Where Sign in and Get started lead.
company.localesHint: Codes separated by commas. The first is the default.
company.previewHint: The footer and contact page read like this.
company.previewEmpty: Fill in the details to see them here.

social.note: Enter a handle (like @name) or a full address. Empty ones are not shown. They also feed the site's structured data.
social.title: Social profiles

seo.note: Defaults for search results and social sharing. Each page can override them.
seo.titleTemplateHint: Use {title} where the page title goes, for example {title} | Company.
seo.descriptionHint: Up to {{count}} characters reads best in search results.
seo.tooLong: A description over {{count}} characters may be cut short in search results.
seo.brandHint: Pick from the media library. Upload pictures there first.
seo.ogImageHint: Shown when a link is shared. 1200 x 630 works well.
seo.analyticsHint: Off by default: the site works with no tracking at all.
seo.analyticsOnHint: Needs an ID and a cookie notice before it can be published.
seo.cookieNoticeHint: Shown to visitors when analytics is on.

banner.note: A short announcement above the site's header. It shows only while it is switched on and, if set, inside its dates.
banner.title: Announcement banner
banner.activeHint: Off hides it without losing the text.
banner.linkHint: A full address, or a path on the site like /pricing.
banner.windowHint: Times are in your browser's time zone. The site is rebuilt on publish, so the window is checked in the visitor's browser.

pages.title: Title
pages.slugHint: Lower case letters, digits and dashes, like data-processing.
pages.slugBad: Lower case letters, digits and single dashes only
pages.emptyHint: Start with the legal pages: privacy, terms, cookies, refunds, acceptable use and data processing, in each language.
pages.lawyer: The starter texts are outlines, not legal advice. Have a lawyer review every legal page for the places where you operate before you publish. The publish check refuses a page that still has the outline's TODO lines.
pages.templateHint: Pick one of the standard pages to start from an outline.
pages.useTemplate: Start from the outline (review with your lawyer)
pages.markedPublished: Marked as published. It goes public with the next publish.
pages.markedDraft: Marked as draft. It leaves the site with the next publish.
pages.publishedNote: This page is marked published. Saved edits go public with the next publish.
pages.stale: Someone saved a newer version of this page. Reload to see it; your edits here are not saved.
pages.bodyHint: Headings with #, lists with -, links as [text](address). Raw HTML is never shown.
pages.pictures: Insert a picture from the library
pages.noteHint: What you changed, in a few words.
pages.restored: Version {{version}} restored as a new version
pages.restoreMessage: Version {{version}} becomes the newest version. Nothing is lost: the history keeps every version.
pages.diffSummary: Version {{older}} compared with {{newer}}: {{added}} line(s) added, {{removed}} removed
pages.deleteMessage: Only drafts that were never on the live site can be deleted. This cannot be undone.

media.note: Pictures are checked and re-saved on upload: camera and location data is removed. PNG, JPEG or WebP only, up to 1.5 MB.
media.altHint: Read aloud by screen readers and shown if the picture does not load.
media.emptyHint: Add a logo, an icon and a sharing image first.
media.removeMessage: {{name}} will be deleted from the library. It cannot be removed while a setting, a page or the live site uses it.

pricing.note: These are the public plans exactly as the website receives them. Plans and prices are edited in Plans.
pricing.emptyHint: The pricing page will show a Get in touch state until a plan is made public.
pricing.rebuild: A change to plans reaches the site at its next rebuild (publish, or a rebuild from the site's host).

publish.neverPublished: Nothing has been published yet. The site shows its built-in placeholder content.
publish.noChanges: No changes since the last publish.
publish.noHook: No rebuild address is configured (ZIIRA_SITE_BUILD_HOOK_URL): publishing makes the content available, and the site must be rebuilt by hand.
publish.checkHint: Required details, legal pages in every language, no placeholder text, working links.
publish.notReady: {{count}} problem(s) to fix before this can be published.

codes.locale_off: Page in a language that is not enabled

publish.confirmBody: This makes the following public and asks the site to rebuild. It is recorded in the audit trail.
publish.noteHint: Why you are publishing, for the history.
publish.historyEmptyHint: Each publish is listed here with who made it and how the site rebuild went.

retried.pending: The rebuild call failed; it will be retried
